global_goals: Optimize On-Device AI Performance and Speed for Complex Models (e.g., Vision Transformers, LLMs)
Enhance Memory and Energy Efficiency across all Edge AI Workloads and Devices
Maximize Hardware Utilization and Acceleration for Low-Bit Quantization on Mobile NPUs

repo_mapping.radar-autonomous-agent: No specific research needs identified from README snippet; its own function is to identify opportunities.
repo_mapping.core-inference-engine: Research into adaptive quantization, sparse model techniques, efficient cross-attention mechanisms, and NPU-specific optimizations for INT4/INT8 inference to reduce RAM pressure and improve VLM inference speed.
repo_mapping.galaxy-vision-pipeline: Research on memory and computationally efficient Vision Transformers (ViT) for mobile devices, advanced low-light denoising with efficient attention mechanisms, and hardware-aware acceleration for vision tasks.
repo_mapping.smartthings-iot-hub: Research into dynamic, energy-aware scheduling algorithms (TinyML, adaptive polling) for IoT devices and efficient distributed edge inference techniques to extend battery life and reduce data aggregation overhead.
repo_mapping.on-device-llm-runtime: Research on KV cache compression, paging, and offloading techniques, as well as advanced speculative decoding methods to overcome memory bottlenecks and accelerate token generation for on-device LLMs.
